isolation: A separate macOS guest on Apple Silicon. No host desktop automation. Tart runs with --no-graphics --no-audio --no-clipboard --no-usb-accessories. Only the dedicated payload and results folder is shared.
capture: VoiceOver's actual sampled last phrase. Identical consecutive phrases and phrases replaced between polls cannot be distinguished. This is not a complete utterance stream.
permissions: Scripting, Accessibility and AppleEvents permissions are required inside the guest. The provisioner refuses physical Macs and never disables SIP. If guest permissions cannot be configured, it fails with the exact error.
